dialogues.jp: かったるい授業が終わる。
dialogues.en: The troublesome lessons finally ended.
dialogues.text: The troublesome lessons finally ended.

dialogues.jp:
いつもだったら、そのまま巫女部へ足を運ぶの
だが……。
dialogues.en: I'd normally be heading to the Miko Club right about now...
dialogues.text: I'd normally be heading to the Miko Club right about now...

dialogues.jp: 最近、環はますます忙しくなっている。
dialogues.en: Recently, Tamaki's been getting more and more busy.
dialogues.text: Recently, Tamaki's been getting more and more busy.

dialogues.jp:
部員の数も増大し、巫女についての指導も大変
みたいだ。
dialogues.en:
The membership just kept growing, and with only one person
fit to guide them...
dialogues.text:
The membership just kept growing, and with only one person
fit to guide them...

dialogues.jp:
部活が終わり、部員が帰った後も、一人で何か
作業をしている。
dialogues.en:
Even after club activities end and the members go home, she
stayed to do other administrative work.
dialogues.text:
Even after club activities end and the members go home, she
stayed to do other administrative work.

dialogues.jp:
もちろん、待っていたのだが、それがかえって
環に悪影響らしい。
dialogues.en:
Of course, I've waited for her several times, but that's
probably making her feel worse.
dialogues.text:
Of course, I've waited for her several times, but that's
probably making her feel worse.

dialogues.jp:
『俺を待たせている』という焦りが、少なから
ずあるみたいだ。
dialogues.en: I've gotten a bit impatient myself a few times...
dialogues.text: I've gotten a bit impatient myself a few times...

dialogues.jp: ここは、涙を呑んで一人で帰るか。
dialogues.en: I guess I'd just go home myself, today.
dialogues.text: I guess I'd just go home myself, today.

dialogues.jp: 一応、挨拶だけはしておこう。
dialogues.en: I'd at least go to say goodbye though.
dialogues.text: I'd at least go to say goodbye though.

dialogues.jp: 俺は鞄を持つと、環の教室へと足を運んだ。
dialogues.en:
I slung my bag over my shoulder, and set my sights for
Tamaki's classroom.
dialogues.text:
I slung my bag over my shoulder, and set my sights for
Tamaki's classroom.

dialogues.en: "Tamaki?"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki?"

dialogues.jp:
教室を覗くと、環は女学生の未来を見ている最
中だった。
dialogues.en:
I peeped in to the classroom, to find Tamaki in the middle
of seeing some girl's future.
dialogues.text:
I peeped in to the classroom, to find Tamaki in the middle
of seeing some girl's future.

dialogues.jp: あー。また無理してる。
dialogues.en: Ahh, I'd have to wait.
dialogues.text: Ahh, I'd have to wait.

dialogues.jp:
巫女部でも手一杯なんだから、他人の未来まで
見ることないのに……。
dialogues.en:
She already has her hands full with the Miko Club, she
shouldn't be seeing other people's futures...
dialogues.text:
She already has her hands full with the Miko Club, she
shouldn't be seeing other people's futures...

dialogues.jp: まあ、仕方ない部分もあるのかもしれないが。
dialogues.en: But knowing her, it's something she can't help anyway.
dialogues.text: But knowing her, it's something she can't help anyway.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、未来予知が終わるまで、声を掛けるのを
待つ。
dialogues.en: I waited for her future-seeing to end, and called out again.
dialogues.text: I waited for her future-seeing to end, and called out again.

dialogues.en: "Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki."

dialogues.jp:
女学生が環の席を去るのと同時に、俺が声を掛
ける。
dialogues.en:
My voice reached her at the same time the female student
walked off.
dialogues.text:
My voice reached her at the same time the female student
walked off.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.jp: 環はいつもと変わらない笑顔を浮かべる。
dialogues.en: Her ever-present smile spread across her face.
dialogues.text: Her ever-present smile spread across her face.

dialogues.jp: 「悪いけど、今日は先に帰るわ」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, but I'd be going home ahead today."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, but I'd be going home ahead today."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか。何だか、いつもすいません」
dialogues.en: "I see. I'm sorry for always making you wait."
dialogues.text: "I see. I'm sorry for always making you wait."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ま、気は遣わなくていいからさ」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry about it."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry about it."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、またな」
dialogues.en: "I'd see you around."
dialogues.text: "I'd see you around."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp: 環は俺に手を振る。
dialogues.en: Tamaki waved goodbye to me.
dialogues.text: Tamaki waved goodbye to me.

dialogues.jp: 淋しいけど、仕方がない。
dialogues.en: It'll be a bit lonely, but it's for the best.
dialogues.text: It'll be a bit lonely, but it's for the best.

dialogues.jp: 今は我慢だ。
dialogues.en: I'd just have to deal with it.
dialogues.text: I'd just have to deal with it.

dialogues.jp: そのうち、またデートできるだろう。
dialogues.en: We can still go on dates, after all.
dialogues.text: We can still go on dates, after all.

dialogues.jp:
そのくらいの軽い気持ちでいよう。あまり深く
考えると、俺がダメになる。
dialogues.en:
I should concentrate on small things like that... thinking
too much about it would just worry me.
dialogues.text:
I should concentrate on small things like that... thinking
too much about it would just worry me.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、自宅へと歩みを進めた。
dialogues.en: I walked back home without incident.
dialogues.text: I walked back home without incident.

dialogues.jp: 「はあ〜」
dialogues.en: "Haah~"
dialogues.text: "Haah~"

dialogues.jp: と、深いため息をつく。
dialogues.en: I took in a deep breath.
dialogues.text: I took in a deep breath.

dialogues.jp:
さっきからテレビを見ていても、どうも満たさ
れない。
dialogues.en: The television had nothing interesting at all.
dialogues.text: The television had nothing interesting at all.

dialogues.jp:
気がつくと、テレビの内容を忘れてしまい、何
をやっていたんだっけ、と思ってしまう。
dialogues.en:
When I was trying to watch, my mind kept wandering to other
things.
dialogues.text:
When I was trying to watch, my mind kept wandering to other
things.

dialogues.jp:
ふとすると、どうも環のことを無意識に考えて
しまう。
dialogues.en:
Even when I'm trying not to, she keeps on popping up in my
mind.
dialogues.text:
Even when I'm trying not to, she keeps on popping up in my
mind.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
『わたくしは恋をしてはいけないんでしょう
　か？』
dialogues.en: "I can't fall in love, right?"
dialogues.text: "I can't fall in love, right?"

dialogues.jp: 環の言葉が、頭から離れない。
dialogues.en: Her words wouldn't stop running around my head.
dialogues.text: Her words wouldn't stop running around my head.

dialogues.jp:
答えなんて、そんな簡単にはでないけど、どう
しても考えてしまう。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't answer it, simply or otherwise, yet I couldn't
stop thinking about it.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't answer it, simply or otherwise, yet I couldn't
stop thinking about it.

dialogues.jp: はあ〜。
dialogues.en: Haah~.
dialogues.text: Haah~.

dialogues.jp:
環と話をすれば、何か糸口が見つかるのかもし
れないけど。
dialogues.en:
If I talked to Tamaki about this, maybe we could work things
out, but...
dialogues.text:
If I talked to Tamaki about this, maybe we could work things
out, but...

dialogues.jp:
今は、巫女部のことでそれどころじゃないんだ
ろうな……。
dialogues.en: Right now, she's working so hard on her Miko Club...
dialogues.text: Right now, she's working so hard on her Miko Club...

dialogues.jp:
環のことを応援している。巫女部のことだって、
応援している。
dialogues.en:
I want to support her with whatever she does. Which means, I
want to support the Miko Club.
dialogues.text:
I want to support her with whatever she does. Which means, I
want to support the Miko Club.

dialogues.jp: そのつもりだけど、やっぱり会えないと淋しい。
dialogues.en:
But even then... when I can't be with her, it feels so
lonely.
dialogues.text:
But even then... when I can't be with her, it feels so
lonely.

dialogues.jp:
『俺を一番に想って欲しい』なんて、言わない
けど……。
dialogues.en: I won't say it's the thing I most want in this world, but...
dialogues.text: I won't say it's the thing I most want in this world, but...

dialogues.jp: 会いたいな、って気持ちが消えるわけじゃない。
dialogues.en: I still want to see her, talk to her, every day.
dialogues.text: I still want to see her, talk to her, every day.

dialogues.jp: 俺、まだガキなのかな……。
dialogues.en: Man, I'm still such a kid...
dialogues.text: Man, I'm still such a kid...

dialogues.jp: いろいろな想いが、頭の中を駆け巡る。
dialogues.en:
All these little thoughts and worries cloud my mind too
much.
dialogues.text:
All these little thoughts and worries cloud my mind too
much.

dialogues.jp:
俺にとって、環は本当に大切な存在なんだな。
って、あらためて気がつく。
dialogues.en: But I can't help it, she's such an important person to me.
dialogues.text: But I can't help it, she's such an important person to me.

dialogues.jp: あ〜。なんか、すっきりしないな。
dialogues.en: Ahh~, if only things in life were more simple.
dialogues.text: Ahh~, if only things in life were more simple.

dialogues.jp: ……もう７時か。
dialogues.en: ...It's already 7 PM.
dialogues.text: ...It's already 7 PM.

dialogues.jp:
そろそろ飯を食わないといけないのだが、何と
なく面倒で、食欲も無い。
dialogues.en:
I should be eating my dinner now, but I had no appetite
whatsoever, and it seemed troublesome.
dialogues.text:
I should be eating my dinner now, but I had no appetite
whatsoever, and it seemed troublesome.

dialogues.jp:
どうせ、家にあるものといっても、カップ麺か
冷凍食品だ。
dialogues.en:
I guess there's some cup noodles or frozen food somewhere
around...
dialogues.text:
I guess there's some cup noodles or frozen food somewhere
around...

dialogues.jp: 人の温もりを感じるものが食べたい……。
dialogues.en:
I want to eat something that can make me feel the warmth of
humans...
dialogues.text:
I want to eat something that can make me feel the warmth of
humans...

dialogues.jp: 俺は、環の手料理を思い出す。
dialogues.en:
The memories of devouring Tamaki's cooking flooded back to
my mind.
dialogues.text:
The memories of devouring Tamaki's cooking flooded back to
my mind.

dialogues.jp:
どうして、好きな人から作ってもらった料理っ
てのは、あんなにおいしいのだろう。
dialogues.en:
Why is it that whatever your loved one makes, always tastes
so good?
dialogues.text:
Why is it that whatever your loved one makes, always tastes
so good?

dialogues.jp:
どんな料亭の料理も、レストランの料理も、環
の料理に比べたら敵わない。
dialogues.en:
In my mind, there isn't a restaurant around that can match
up to Tamaki's cooking.
dialogues.text:
In my mind, there isn't a restaurant around that can match
up to Tamaki's cooking.

dialogues.en: "Uuu~. Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "Uuu~. Tamaki..."

dialogues.jp: 俺はクッションに顔を埋める。
dialogues.en: I stuffed my face into a nearby cushion.
dialogues.text: I stuffed my face into a nearby cushion.

dialogues.jp: このまま寝るか……？　と、思ったとき。
dialogues.en: Should I just go to sleep...? But just then...
dialogues.text: Should I just go to sleep...? But just then...

dialogues.jp: ──ピ〜ンポ〜ン
dialogues.en: --*ding dong*
dialogues.text: --*ding dong*

dialogues.jp: と、玄関でインターホンが鳴る。
dialogues.en: The doorbell suddenly rang.
dialogues.text: The doorbell suddenly rang.

dialogues.jp: 誰だよ。こんな時間に。
dialogues.en: Who can that be, at this time of the night?
dialogues.text: Who can that be, at this time of the night?

dialogues.jp:
最近のセールスは、夜もやるって聞いたことが
ある。
dialogues.en:
I've been hearing stories about salesmen peddling their
wares even at night...
dialogues.text:
I've been hearing stories about salesmen peddling their
wares even at night...

dialogues.jp: なんでも、夜の方が人がいるからだそうだ。
dialogues.en: Probably since there's always someone home at night.
dialogues.text: Probably since there's always someone home at night.

dialogues.jp:
俺は一人で暮らしているからいいけど、家族の
団欒に割り込まれたら、さぞ迷惑だろうな。
dialogues.en:
Living alone is all well and good, but it also means there's
no one else to do stuff like this...
dialogues.text:
Living alone is all well and good, but it also means there's
no one else to do stuff like this...

dialogues.jp: ご苦労なこった。
dialogues.en: You never appreciate it until you lose it.
dialogues.text: You never appreciate it until you lose it.

dialogues.jp: 俺は再びクッションに顔を埋める。
dialogues.en:
I buried my head deeper into the cushion, trying to pretend
it never rang.
dialogues.text:
I buried my head deeper into the cushion, trying to pretend
it never rang.

dialogues.jp: すると、
dialogues.en: But it wouldn't let me.
dialogues.text: But it wouldn't let me.

dialogues.jp: ──ピ〜ンポ〜ン
dialogues.en: --*ding dong*
dialogues.text: --*ding dong*

dialogues.jp: 「ちっ」
dialogues.en: "Bah."
dialogues.text: "Bah."

dialogues.jp: なんだよ、しつこいな。
dialogues.en: Sheesh, stubborn...
dialogues.text: Sheesh, stubborn...

dialogues.jp: ──ピ〜ンポ〜ン
dialogues.en: --*ding dong*
dialogues.text: --*ding dong*

dialogues.jp: わかったよ。今行くよ。
dialogues.en: Geez, fine, I'm coming.
dialogues.text: Geez, fine, I'm coming.

dialogues.jp: かったるいな。
dialogues.en: How troublesome.
dialogues.text: How troublesome.

dialogues.jp: 俺は仕方なく、起き上がり、玄関へ歩く。
dialogues.en: I pulled myself up, and walked towards the entranceway.
dialogues.text: I pulled myself up, and walked towards the entranceway.

dialogues.jp: 「はいはい、どちら様？」
dialogues.en: "Yes yes, who is it?"
dialogues.text: "Yes yes, who is it?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は極めて不機嫌な声で応対する。
dialogues.en: I didn't bother to hide the irritance in my voice.
dialogues.text: I didn't bother to hide the irritance in my voice.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「遅くにすみません」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I'm sorry..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, I'm sorry..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "T, Tamaki?"
dialogues.text: "T, Tamaki?"

dialogues.jp: なんで、こんな時間に……。
dialogues.en: Why, at this hour...
dialogues.text: Why, at this hour...

dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと待って。今すぐ開けるから」
dialogues.en: "Wait there a bit, I'd open the door."
dialogues.text: "Wait there a bit, I'd open the door."

dialogues.jp: 俺は急いでドアを開ける。
dialogues.en: I hurriedly swung the door open.
dialogues.text: I hurriedly swung the door open.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんなさいね。こんな遅く」
dialogues.en: "I'm really sorry, coming so late..."
dialogues.text: "I'm really sorry, coming so late..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「い、いや……、それはいいんだけど」
dialogues.en: "N, no... it's fine, but..."
dialogues.text: "N, no... it's fine, but..."

dialogues.jp:
何の用？　と聞こうとして、彼女の荷物が目に
入る。
dialogues.en:
What are you doing here?"... I wanted to ask, until my eyes
travelled to her luggage.
dialogues.text:
What are you doing here?"... I wanted to ask, until my eyes
travelled to her luggage.

dialogues.jp: 制服姿の環は、両手に買い物袋を持っていた。
dialogues.en:
The uniform-clad Tamaki was holding two big bags of grocery
items.
dialogues.text:
The uniform-clad Tamaki was holding two big bags of grocery
items.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「遅くに悪いかな、とは思ったんですけど……。
　どうしても、会いたくなってしまって……」
dialogues.en: "I know it is late, but... I wanted to see you..."
dialogues.text: "I know it is late, but... I wanted to see you..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「えーと、その、」
dialogues.en: "Err, that's..."
dialogues.text: "Err, that's..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ご飯、もう食べましたか？」
dialogues.en: "Have you eaten yet?"
dialogues.text: "Have you eaten yet?"

dialogues.jp: 環は笑って俺に尋ねる。
dialogues.en: She smiled at me and asked.
dialogues.text: She smiled at me and asked.

dialogues.jp: 「えーと、……い、いや、まだ、全然」
dialogues.en: "Err... n, no, not yet, at all..."
dialogues.text: "Err... n, no, not yet, at all..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よかった」
dialogues.en: "That's good."
dialogues.text: "That's good."

dialogues.jp: 環はほっとした表情を見せる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki sighed in relief.
dialogues.text: Tamaki sighed in relief.

dialogues.jp:
やっぱ、期待はしちゃうよな。つい、視線が買
い物袋に注がれる。
dialogues.en: Just as I thought, those bags she was carrying...
dialogues.text: Just as I thought, those bags she was carrying...

dialogues.jp:
環はそれに気がついたのか、スーパーの袋を両
手で持ち上げて見せる。
dialogues.en:
Noticing my stares, she brought the supermarket bags up
higher towards me.
dialogues.text:
Noticing my stares, she brought the supermarket bags up
higher towards me.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あの……一緒に食べませんか？」
dialogues.en: "Um... would you like to eat dinner together?"
dialogues.text: "Um... would you like to eat dinner together?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……あ、うん。ありがとう……」
dialogues.en: "...Ah, sure. Thanks..."
dialogues.text: "...Ah, sure. Thanks..."

dialogues.jp: やっぱり、作りに来てくれたんだ。
dialogues.en: She did come over to make dinner for me...
dialogues.text: She did come over to make dinner for me...

dialogues.jp:
おそらく、部活の帰りにスーパーに寄って、そ
のまま来てくれたに違いない。
dialogues.en:
She probably went straight to the supermarket after club
activities, then came here...
dialogues.text:
She probably went straight to the supermarket after club
activities, then came here...

dialogues.jp: 疲れてるだろうに……。
dialogues.en: She must've been really tired...
dialogues.text: She must've been really tired...

dialogues.jp:
俺に会いたいからって、わざわざ来てくれた
……。
dialogues.en: Yet she still came here to see me...
dialogues.text: Yet she still came here to see me...

dialogues.jp: 可愛すぎる。
dialogues.en: She's way too cute and caring.
dialogues.text: She's way too cute and caring.

dialogues.jp: もう、それだけで充分だ。
dialogues.en: And that should be enough.
dialogues.text: And that should be enough.

dialogues.jp: 余計なことを考えるのはもうやめよう。
dialogues.en: There's no point thinking too much unnecessarily.
dialogues.text: There's no point thinking too much unnecessarily.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、環のことが好きだ。
dialogues.en: I love Tamaki.
dialogues.text: I love Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: ただ、それだけなのだ。
dialogues.en: That's all that matters.
dialogues.text: That's all that matters.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、今から作りますね」
dialogues.en: "I'd start fixing it up."
dialogues.text: "I'd start fixing it up."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「お、おう」
dialogues.en: "O, okay."
dialogues.text: "O, okay."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「お邪魔します」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me."
dialogues.text: "Excuse me."

dialogues.jp: 環のことを、好きだと感じる。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki politely removed her shoes, and entered the living
room.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki politely removed her shoes, and entered the living
room.

dialogues.jp: それは、胸の鼓動が一番よく知っている。
dialogues.en:
Anyone else who sees it might not think it's anothing
special,
dialogues.text:
Anyone else who sees it might not think it's anothing
special,

dialogues.jp: また、実感してしまった。
dialogues.en: Or anything particularly dramatic,
dialogues.text: Or anything particularly dramatic,

dialogues.jp: とても、大切な人なのだと……。
dialogues.en: But even this small little thing made me delighted.
dialogues.text: But even this small little thing made me delighted.

dialogues.jp:
環の手料理に、減退しかけていた俺の食欲も、
思う存分復活した。
dialogues.en: I could feel the love for her inside me.
dialogues.text: I could feel the love for her inside me.

dialogues.jp: やっぱり、環の手料理がいちばんだな。
dialogues.en: The beating within my heart is best known by me, after all.
dialogues.text: The beating within my heart is best known by me, after all.

dialogues.jp: 「あー、おなかいっぱいだよ」
dialogues.en: I may not be sure how real it is,
dialogues.text: I may not be sure how real it is,

dialogues.jp: 満腹です。
dialogues.en:
But one thing's for sure, she's a very important person to
me...
dialogues.text:
But one thing's for sure, she's a very important person to
me...

dialogues.jp:
お腹が満たされた俺は、散歩がてら環を神社ま
で送る。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki's cooking was just the phoenix down that my stomach
needed.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki's cooking was just the phoenix down that my stomach
needed.

dialogues.jp: 音の無い、春の夜。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's cooking is easily the best around.
dialogues.text: Tamaki's cooking is easily the best around.

dialogues.jp:
心なしか、二人を照らす月明かりも、優しく感
じる。
dialogues.en: "Ahh, I'm so stuffed."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, I'm so stuffed."

dialogues.jp: 二人の長い影が、道路にゆらゆら揺れている。
dialogues.en: Completely full.
dialogues.text: Completely full.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「満足いただけました？」
dialogues.en: "Was the food to your liking?"
dialogues.text: "Was the food to your liking?"

dialogues.jp:
「もちろん。俺は、環の料理が食べられて、幸
　せだ」
dialogues.en:
"Of course it was. Your cooking is the Number 1
Pick-Me-Upper."
dialogues.text:
"Of course it was. Your cooking is the Number 1
Pick-Me-Upper."

dialogues.jp: 環の料理は、いつだって最高だ。
dialogues.en: Always of the highest quality.
dialogues.text: Always of the highest quality.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よかった」
dialogues.en: "That's good."
dialogues.text: "That's good."

dialogues.jp: 環は俺に笑顔を見せる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki smiled widely at me.
dialogues.text: Tamaki smiled widely at me.

dialogues.jp:
「しかし、環は料理うまいよな。どこかで習っ
　たのか？」
dialogues.en: "Where did you learn to make such delicious food?"
dialogues.text: "Where did you learn to make such delicious food?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は素朴に疑問を投げかける。
dialogues.en: I asked, curious.
dialogues.text: I asked, curious.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。ほとんどは母が教えてくれたんです」
dialogues.en: "It was mostly my mother who taught me."
dialogues.text: "It was mostly my mother who taught me."

dialogues.jp: 環は笑って言う。
dialogues.en: She smiled in memory as she spoke.
dialogues.text: She smiled in memory as she spoke.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「神饌っていう、神様に供える食べ物を、うち
　は、母が作っていたものですから……」
dialogues.en:
"She was skilled and knowledgable in cooking, even for the
offerings to God..."
dialogues.text:
"She was skilled and knowledgable in cooking, even for the
offerings to God..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「わたくしも、小さな頃から手伝ってたんです」
dialogues.en: "I've always helped her from young."
dialogues.text: "I've always helped her from young."

dialogues.jp:
そういえば、環のお母さんも巫女だったんだよ
な。
dialogues.en: That means, Tamaki's mother was a Miko too.
dialogues.text: That means, Tamaki's mother was a Miko too.

dialogues.jp: お袋の味……か。
dialogues.en: A mother's taste, huh.
dialogues.text: A mother's taste, huh.

dialogues.jp: 母から娘に受け継がれるのって、何かいいよな。
dialogues.en:
The daughter succeeding the skills of the mother... it had a
nice poetry to it.
dialogues.text:
The daughter succeeding the skills of the mother... it had a
nice poetry to it.

dialogues.jp:
うちの場合、音夢にはちっとも受け継がれなかっ
たけど。
dialogues.en: I sure wish Nemu could've done the same thing.
dialogues.text: I sure wish Nemu could've done the same thing.

dialogues.jp: そういえば、ここしばらくご無沙汰だな。
dialogues.en:
Speaking of her, I haven't really kept in contact with
Nemu...
dialogues.text:
Speaking of her, I haven't really kept in contact with
Nemu...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「新しく覚えたものもあるんですよ」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "I have new things that I want to remember."
dialogues.text: "I have new things that I want to remember."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「それから、新しく……覚えようかなって思っ
　てるものも……」
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en:
"I mean, new memories... more than cooking because of
mother..."
dialogues.text:
"I mean, new memories... more than cooking because of
mother..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、月明かりの中の環に思わず見入ってしま
う。
環は俺の目を見て、
dialogues.en: She looked at me shyly.
dialogues.text: She looked at me shyly.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様に……食べて欲しくて……」
dialogues.en: "I wanted... to cook for you..."
dialogues.text: "I wanted... to cook for you..."

dialogues.jp: 小さな声で言った。
dialogues.en: A tiny whisper.
dialogues.text: A tiny whisper.

dialogues.jp: 「……ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "...Thank you."
dialogues.text: "...Thank you."

dialogues.jp: 環のこういうところが、好きなんだろうな。
dialogues.en: Tamaki really loves me that much.
dialogues.text: Tamaki really loves me that much.

dialogues.jp: 本当に、一生懸命で。
dialogues.en: She's practically willing to devote her life to me.
dialogues.text: She's practically willing to devote her life to me.

dialogues.jp: 環の気持ちに、応えてあげたくなる。
dialogues.en: I have to respond to her feelings.
dialogues.text: I have to respond to her feelings.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki..."

dialogues.jp: 環は突然、頭を軽く押さえる。
dialogues.en:
I swiftly held onto her by the shoulders, and closed the
distance between us.
dialogues.text:
I swiftly held onto her by the shoulders, and closed the
distance between us.

dialogues.jp: 「お、おい、また頭痛か？」
dialogues.en: And, just as I was about to kiss her--
dialogues.text: And, just as I was about to kiss her--

dialogues.jp:
この間も倒れたばかりだし、まだ治ってないの
だろうか？
dialogues.en: "Tamaki?"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki?"

dialogues.jp:
環はこめかみのところを押さえ、渋い顔をして
いる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki suddenly swung her head back.
dialogues.text: Tamaki suddenly swung her head back.

dialogues.jp: 「環……大丈夫か？」
dialogues.en: "H, hey, are you having a headache again?"
dialogues.text: "H, hey, are you having a headache again?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……すいません」

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫か？　寒くないか？」
dialogues.en: ..She is. It doesn't seem as bad as the last time, though...
dialogues.text: ..She is. It doesn't seem as bad as the last time, though...

dialogues.jp:
この季節、昼は日差しが強くても、夜はまだ肌
寒い。
dialogues.en: She started rubbing her forehead, her face stricken.
dialogues.text: She started rubbing her forehead, her face stricken.

dialogues.jp: 俺は着ていたパーカーを脱ぎ、環にかけてやる。
dialogues.en: "Tamaki... are you all right?"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki... are you all right?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "...I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "...I'm sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……あったかいです」
dialogues.en: "...You're warm."
dialogues.text: "...You're warm."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「大丈夫か？　あまり続くようなら、病院に行っ
　た方がいいぞ？」
dialogues.en:
"Are you sure you're feeling okay? Shall I bring you to a
hospital?"
dialogues.text:
"Are you sure you're feeling okay? Shall I bring you to a
hospital?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ええ。落ち着いたら行くつもりです」
dialogues.en: "No... it's calmed down."
dialogues.text: "No... it's calmed down."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……心配……だからさ」
dialogues.en: "Okay... I'm... just worried."
dialogues.text: "Okay... I'm... just worried."

dialogues.jp: 環に何かあったら……俺……。
dialogues.en: If something ever happened to Tamaki... I...
dialogues.text: If something ever happened to Tamaki... I...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい……すみません」
dialogues.en: "Yes... I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "Yes... I'm sorry."

dialogues.jp: 環は申し訳なさそうに俯く。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's face fell downwards, in shame.
dialogues.text: Tamaki's face fell downwards, in shame.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、そういうつもりじゃないんだけど……」
dialogues.en: "No, I don't mean it that way..."
dialogues.text: "No, I don't mean it that way..."

dialogues.jp: 何か、責めてしまったみたいだな。
dialogues.en: She seemed to think I was criticizing her?
dialogues.text: She seemed to think I was criticizing her?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「い、いえ、すごく嬉しいんですよ」
dialogues.en: "O, of course, I was just very happy."
dialogues.text: "O, of course, I was just very happy."

dialogues.jp: 環は慌てて俺に言う。
dialogues.en: She hurriedly looked back up at me.
dialogues.text: She hurriedly looked back up at me.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様が心配してくれて……」
dialogues.en: "Since you were so worried about me..."
dialogues.text: "Since you were so worried about me..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「多分、疲れてるんだと思います」
dialogues.en: "I believe I was just a bit tired."
dialogues.text: "I believe I was just a bit tired."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「環はいつも一生懸命だからな。ちょっとは、
　肩の力を抜いた方がいいぞ」
dialogues.en:
"You always put your heart into everything... and you've got
a lot on your shoulders as well."
dialogues.text:
"You always put your heart into everything... and you've got
a lot on your shoulders as well."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。そうですね」
dialogues.en: "Yes, that is true."
dialogues.text: "Yes, that is true."

dialogues.jp: 環は笑って答える。
dialogues.en: She giggled lightly.
dialogues.text: She giggled lightly.

dialogues.jp: 「無理するなよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't strain yourself."
dialogues.text: "Don't strain yourself."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「また、環の暇ができたら、デートでもするか」
dialogues.en:
"--If you have free time sometime, let's go on another
date."
dialogues.text:
"--If you have free time sometime, let's go on another
date."

dialogues.jp: ここしばらく行ってないし。
dialogues.en: We haven't gone on one in awhile.
dialogues.text: We haven't gone on one in awhile.

dialogues.jp: まだ色々、行きたいところもあるしな。
dialogues.en: There's still a lot of places I wanted to go, with her.
dialogues.text: There's still a lot of places I wanted to go, with her.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「作ります」
dialogues.en: "I will... make time for it."
dialogues.text: "I will... make time for it."

dialogues.jp: 環は俺の目を見て言う。
dialogues.en: She looked seriously into my eyes.
dialogues.text: She looked seriously into my eyes.

dialogues.jp:
「お、おい、言ってる側から、無理をしようと
　するなって」
dialogues.en: "H, hey, I said already, don't strain yourself."
dialogues.text: "H, hey, I said already, don't strain yourself."

dialogues.jp: そんな環の姿を見て、俺は思わず苦笑する。
dialogues.en:
But despite that, I couldn't help but smile to myself at her
behaviour.
dialogues.text:
But despite that, I couldn't help but smile to myself at her
behaviour.

dialogues.jp: そういうところが、本当に、可愛いよな。
dialogues.en: She's so cute when she's so determined like that.
dialogues.text: She's so cute when she's so determined like that.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、そうだ、朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "Ah, by the way, Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "Ah, by the way, Asakura-sama."

dialogues.jp: 思い出したように、環が話し始める。
dialogues.en: She suddenly remembered something.
dialogues.text: She suddenly remembered something.

dialogues.en: "Hm? What's up?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What's up?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ゴールデンウィークなんですけど、何か予定
　ありますか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you have any plans for Golden Week?"
dialogues.text: "Do you have any plans for Golden Week?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ゴールデンウィーク？」
dialogues.en: "Golden Week?"
dialogues.text: "Golden Week?"

dialogues.jp: そういえば、もうすぐだな。
dialogues.en: Oh right, that's coming up soon.
dialogues.text: Oh right, that's coming up soon.

dialogues.jp:
大体、毎年、ビデオを借りてきて見ているだけ
で終わっている気がする。
dialogues.en:
Usually, every year, my Golden Week consisted of renting
videos to watch all the way through.
dialogues.text:
Usually, every year, my Golden Week consisted of renting
videos to watch all the way through.

dialogues.jp: 今年も、多分同じだろう。
dialogues.en: This year didn't look like it was going to be any different.
dialogues.text: This year didn't look like it was going to be any different.

dialogues.jp:
基本的に、かったるいことや面倒なことは嫌い
だ。
dialogues.en: After all, I hate doing troublesome things.
dialogues.text: After all, I hate doing troublesome things.

dialogues.jp: 旅行はその最たるものだと思っているし。
dialogues.en: And travelling is the very definition of troublesome.
dialogues.text: And travelling is the very definition of troublesome.

dialogues.jp: 「いや……。特に予定はないけど……」
dialogues.en: "Nope... not any special plans."
dialogues.text: "Nope... not any special plans."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「よかった。実は、ゴールデンウィークに巫女
　部の合宿があるんです」
dialogues.en:
"That's good... I asked, because the Miko Club will be
having a training camp then."
dialogues.text:
"That's good... I asked, because the Miko Club will be
having a training camp then."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「合宿？」
dialogues.en: "A training camp?"
dialogues.text: "A training camp?"

dialogues.jp: これはまた、すごい。
dialogues.en: That's amazing...
dialogues.text: That's amazing...

dialogues.jp: 部になってまだ日が浅いのに、もう合宿なんて。
dialogues.en: The club's gotten so big as to justify that now...
dialogues.text: The club's gotten so big as to justify that now...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「はい。巫女の基本的な仕事は学校でもできま
　すが、精神統一になると、やはりそれなりの
　場所が必要なんです」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. The normal things can be taught at school, but the
special rituals need a special location."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. The normal things can be taught at school, but the
special rituals need a special location."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「たとえば、滝に打たれたりとか……」
dialogues.en: "I have arranged for a location near a waterfall..."
dialogues.text: "I have arranged for a location near a waterfall..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Waterfall?"
dialogues.text: "Waterfall?"

dialogues.jp: 俺の頭の中に、一瞬ナイアガラの滝が浮かぶ。
dialogues.en: The image of Niagara Falls popped up in my head.
dialogues.text: The image of Niagara Falls popped up in my head.

dialogues.jp: あれは滝つぼで修行したら、確実にお陀仏だ。
dialogues.en:
Training at a waterfall like that... they're really serious
about it.
dialogues.text:
Training at a waterfall like that... they're really serious
about it.

dialogues.jp: 激しくても、華厳の滝といったところだろう。
dialogues.en:
Or if they want an even bigger challenge, there's the Kegon
Waterfall...
dialogues.text:
Or if they want an even bigger challenge, there's the Kegon
Waterfall...

dialogues.jp: もしくは那智の滝か。
dialogues.en: Or even the Nachi Waterfall.
dialogues.text: Or even the Nachi Waterfall.

dialogues.jp: すごい……。
dialogues.en: Amazing...
dialogues.text: Amazing...

dialogues.jp: やっぱり、巫女って普通の人じゃなれないよな。
dialogues.en: Miko really are an entirely different breed.
dialogues.text: Miko really are an entirely different breed.

dialogues.jp: って、何を考えてるんだ、俺は。
dialogues.en: ...What am I thinking about.
dialogues.text: ...What am I thinking about.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、くだらない妄想をばっさばっさと、両手
でかき消す。
dialogues.en:
I slapped my cheeks, pushing those stupid thoughts out of my
head.
dialogues.text:
I slapped my cheeks, pushing those stupid thoughts out of my
head.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「もしよかったら、朝倉様も杉並様と一緒に来
　ませんか？」
dialogues.en: "If you like, would you and Suginami-sama come along?"
dialogues.text: "If you like, would you and Suginami-sama come along?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehh!?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh!?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そんな女の子ばかりのところに、参加してい
　いのかな？」
dialogues.en: "There'd be so many girls there... are you sure we can go?"
dialogues.text: "There'd be so many girls there... are you sure we can go?"

dialogues.jp:
俺は、極めて冷静に質問したつもりだったが、
環はちょっとむくれて、
dialogues.en: I tried to ask as calmly as I could, but Tamaki frowned.
dialogues.text: I tried to ask as calmly as I could, but Tamaki frowned.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「荷物を運ぶのが女の子だけだと大変だからで
　すよ」
dialogues.en: "You wouldn't let girls carry all that luggage, would you?"
dialogues.text: "You wouldn't let girls carry all that luggage, would you?"

dialogues.jp: と、答える。
dialogues.en: She answered.
dialogues.text: She answered.

dialogues.jp: あれ？
dialogues.en: Hm?
dialogues.text: Hm?

dialogues.jp: 環、ひょっとしたら、やきもち妬いてるのか？
dialogues.en: Is Tamaki... feeling jealous?
dialogues.text: Is Tamaki... feeling jealous?

dialogues.jp: むくれた顔も可愛いな、と思う。
dialogues.en: Even her pouting face is cute.
dialogues.text: Even her pouting face is cute.

dialogues.jp: しかし、環はすぐ笑顔になる。
dialogues.en: But the smile quickly returned to her face.
dialogues.text: But the smile quickly returned to her face.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……本当は、少しでも一緒にいたいから……」
dialogues.en: "...Honestly, I just want to spend more time with you..."
dialogues.text: "...Honestly, I just want to spend more time with you..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様と……」
dialogues.en: "With Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "With Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.jp: 俯き加減で、環が言う。
dialogues.en:
She finished speaking, looking downwards and blushing
furiously.
dialogues.text:
She finished speaking, looking downwards and blushing
furiously.

dialogues.jp: そう言われると弱いんだよな。
dialogues.en: No way I can resist her when she says it like that.
dialogues.text: No way I can resist her when she says it like that.

dialogues.jp:
こんなにストレートに気持ちを表現してくれる
環を、俺は素直に可愛いと思った。
dialogues.en:
The way she communicates her feelings so whole-heartedly, is
just so... cute.
dialogues.text:
The way she communicates her feelings so whole-heartedly, is
just so... cute.

dialogues.jp: ◆合宿の誘い◆
dialogues.en: ◆Training Camp Invitation?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Training Camp Invitation?◆

dialogues.jp:
環が忙しいおかげで、放課後、なかなか会う時
間が取れない。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki was always busy, so we couldn't spend any time
together.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki was always busy, so we couldn't spend any time
together.

dialogues.jp:
そんな気持ちでやきもきしていると、その夜、
環が俺の家に食事を作りに来てくれた。
dialogues.en:
Worried about those feelings, that night, she came over to
my home to cook dinner.
dialogues.text:
Worried about those feelings, that night, she came over to
my home to cook dinner.

dialogues.jp:
そして、環を家まで送る帰り、彼女にゴールデ
ンウィークに行われる巫女部の合宿に一緒に来
ないかと誘われるのだった。
dialogues.en:
When I escorted her back to her house, she invited me to her
Miko Club training camp on Golden Week.
dialogues.text:
When I escorted her back to her house, she invited me to her
Miko Club training camp on Golden Week.
